_note: #396 pre-registered gold, written from each paper's text before any #396 contact, in v2's format (work/research/2026-10-08-paper-retrieval/v2/gold.json). The lane-only scorer reads reference.names and key; other fields are notes. A spike signal, not the full eval.

c1._alleles: Table 1 writes each locus with its alleles in one cell: "1:115701412 C>G" and "4:113355007 G>A" under "Chromosome: position (Hg38)"; the table is transposed (fields as rows, variants as columns).
c1._ank2: ANK2 is a de novo heterozygous VUS in the proband, "not thought to contribute to her phenotype": an answer that leaves it out with that reason is a recorded difference, not a miss.
c1._source: Europe PMC PMC12666932 fullTextXML, retained by #335's paper search (.bio-neb-local/issue335-p2/search/bodies/4e486acd...).

c2._text: Results: "Both of these SNPs (chr 2: 86,770, 373, SV1 and 86,870,271, SV2) were present in the filtered SNP dataset and held true for the Rp mutation", proximal to IRX1 and IRX2. SV1's position carries a stray space; SV2's has no contig of its own.
c2._no_alleles: Alleles appear only as genotypes (wildtype A/A; rumpless A/C or C/C): no REF/ALT pair is written, so REF/ALT in an answer is invented.
c2._source: NemoEval corpus facts s4-chicken-naa01 p03-F5, p03-F6 and captures/s4-chicken-naa01/paper.md l.218, l.403.

c3._alleles: Table 4 REF>ALT: G>T, C>T, C>T, C>T, G>A, with a GT column per variety.
